Earth Federation Army Far East Command, Izu Base
Izu Base - Interior
Radha, we're back!
Welcome back, everyone. Good work in Hokkaido.
We're fine, but these guys...
I-I'm beat...
Mock battles are one thing, but three real ones...@When I left the house this morning, I never@thought it would come to this...
You must be the children of Mogami's president.@I'm Radha Bairaban, a <Military Contractor>@attached to the <Special Tactics Instructor Unit>.
We've prepared guest rooms for you.@For those three as well.
...So it doesn't look like we'll be@released anytime soon.
You're Touya Shiun, right?@Major Kai asked me to look after you.@You too, Katia, Melua.
Melua
Oh, yes.
Katia
...Thank you.
Shoko and I were told to stay@at this base for a while too. Thanks in advance.
Sorry for the trouble, and thank you.
Yes, we have rooms ready for you two as well.
Um...@What kind of place is the Special Tactics Instructor@Unit? There are soldiers younger than me, too...
Oh, Seolla. You haven't introduced yourselves yet?
No.@Actually, we only just met them face-to-face.
We met up in the air instead of landing at Yakumo Base...
I see. Touya, the Special Tactics Instructor Unit@researches combat tactics for humanoid weapons like@<Personal Trooper>s and <Armored Module>s.
So it's an elite unit, right?@Then why are there kids in it?
Because they're excellent pilots.@Latune, Arado, and Seolla have actually@survived several wars.
Why would they...
We were trained at a place called <The School>.@We didn't have any other choice.
The School... Like, a school school?
No... A special institution that turned children with@the right abilities into humanoid weapon pilots.
Huh...
It doesn't exist anymore.@We're the last survivors of <The School>.
We're only here thanks to meeting everyone@in the Steel Dragons. Especially Seolla and me.
As for what the Instructors do,@we also run evaluation tests on prototypes.@Most recently, <Mogami Heavy Industries>' Soul Saber.
Yes, I've heard.
Um... If everyone in the Instructors is busy,@I can be the pilot for the tests too.
Absolutely not.
I understand how you feel, but please leave@the evaluation to military personnel.
But I'm the one who handles@the Soul Saber best...
"I'm the one" misses the point.@It has to be a mass-production model that any@trained pilot can get the most out of.
I get that, but someday I want a@one-man-army <Super Robot> in the lineup too,@like the Grungust or the Dygenguar.
Mogami can't mass-produce machines that incredible@right now, even if we could build one.
Yeah, I guess...
Now, let me tell you all your schedules.@First, Arado and Seolla. I'd like you two to be@present for the Granteed investigation.
Investigation... Do we have to do something?
They want you and Seolla, and Lieutenants Hugo@and Aqua, to board the Granteed and see whether@it activates.
(I'm curious about that too...)
Understood, Radha.
Akimi, Akemi, your questioning is tomorrow.@Today, please go to the SRX Lab hangar.@They'll be swapping the Soul Saber's equipment there.
(Swapping its equipment? Now?)
Wait, is the SRX in SRX Lab@THE SRX?!
Sounds like a tongue twister, man.
Oh, you know about the SRX?
Of course! The invincible super robot run by the@<SRX Team>, one of the <Steel Dragons>' ace units!@I'm a huge fan!
What an honor to use their hangar and@facilities! Maybe I'll even get to meet@the SRX Team...
...Ryusei and the others aren't at Izu right now.
Huh, really? That's too bad...
Hey, ain't you reactin' different from@when you saw the Compati Kaiser?
No, no, I think the straight-up super@Compatible Kaiser is amazing too.
But the SRX feels like the pinnacle of engineering,@so to me, it's in a league of its own.
Well, that thing does some complicated transforming.
...May I continue? Kota, Shoko,@please go to Major Kai's office@tomorrow morning at 10.
Haah... Lecture time, huh?
Can't be helped.
No, Major Gilliam wants to talk to Roa.
Is it about the <Dark Brain> remnants?@Got it.
Touya, Katia, Melua. In an hour, Major Gilliam@of Intelligence will begin questioning you.@Until then, please rest here.
...Understood.
What will they do to us during questioning?
They'll just ask you questions.@There's nothing to be scared of, so relax.
Y-Yes...
<Cross Gate> Burst?
Yes, please look at this footage.@Saika, go ahead.
Saika
Yes, sir. Playing it now.
Crossfade
This was recorded today at 1503 by a recon@satellite and the <Cross Gate> monitoring fleet.
I thought something like this would happen someday...
Laker
This footage hasn't been released to the public yet.@Like the Antarctic explosion, there's a gag order@on it even within the military.
Could the cause of today's massive outages be...
Yes. That footage... an abnormal energy@discharge from the Cross Gate,@the Cross Gate Burst.
Around the same time, <Zovorg> mobile weapons and@unknowns appeared near the Cross Gate and@engaged the monitoring fleet and the Hagane.
I thought the Zovorg <Privy Council> had stopped@interfering with the Earth Sphere.
Even they aren't a monolith.@We're currently confirming with Mekibos Borquede.
(Whether he knows or not, it's a grave problem.)
Also, the <Cross Gate Burst> threw the@orbital monitoring network into disarray...
And we suspect several unknowns took advantage@of that to descend to the surface.
And one of those is the Granteed?
Most likely.
Then the unknown that@<Mogami Heavy Industries> recovered, too?
Judging from President Akatsuki's account,@the "Drift Wing" and "Sleeping Beauty" seem to have@come down to Earth before the Cross Gate Burst.
The Drift Wing and the Sleeping Beauty...@Code names, huh?
Yes.
President Akatsuki thinks they belong@to some alien race other than the Zovorg.
Please don't speak of that to anyone.@I've also sworn Mogami Heavy Industries to silence.
You know something, don't you?
That's classified.
You'll find out in due time.@Be patient a little longer.
Sir!
Separately, there's something I must tell you, Major.
What's that?
The Hagane encountered and engaged@<Ares Geist> near the Cross Gate.
What...?!@He... The <Adamatron> that absorbed him was destroyed@in the <Battle in the Boundary Space>!
I saw it with my own eyes as well.@But Ares Geist was revived, transformed,@and emerged from the Cross Gate.
You've got to be kidding. If he's come back,@then the others who were there too...?
It's possible.@However, so far we've only confirmed@Ares Geist.
Then what was that shower of light from the Gate?@It looked like it rained down over a wide area.
Since the massive outages ended,@we've yet to see any abnormal events@caused by that phenomenon.
What about Antarctica? Isn't it connected@to the explosion of the <Fabula Foresse>?
I can't say anything about that yet.@The on-site investigation hasn't even begun.
Hmm... The Cross Gate Burst, the Granteed,@the Drift Wing, Ares Geist,@and the Dark Brain remnants...
All sorts of incidents are happening at once again.@This is... likely an omen.
That's why I want to do what we can now.@Commander Laker, were you able to secure@the Joint Chiefs' assurance?
Yes. The initial investigation of the Granteed@and the Drift Wing has been entrusted to us.
The Chairman of the Joint Chiefs was reluctant...@but I pushed it through, saying we couldn't@waste time transporting them to Paris.
Thank you, sir.@Then we'll begin the investigation@and questioning at once.
Feel free to put the <SRX Project>'s Dr. Robert Oomiya,@Dr. Kenzou Kobayashi, and Dr. Eric Wang@to work under your direction.
Roger.
Izu Base - Hangar
Welp, no good with us either.
It was the same as when Lieutenant Aqua@and the others boarded.
So I guess it really won't start@without Touya and Katia...
Either the Granteed has those two's biometrics@stored in it, or they have authentication devices@implanted in them...
Dr. Oomiya, anything else you've learned?
Robert
As a humanoid mobile weapon, its structure isn't@much different from those of Earth, <La Gias>,@the <Balmar>, or the <Zovorg>.
But it wasn't made by any of them.@If anything, it resembles a <Shura God>.
Huh? How so?
Not in shape, in concept.@It's a weapon made quite a long time ago,@in some other world, by humans like us.
Quite a long time ago...?
Eric
I tried dating the machine's surface, y'see,@and the results were all over the place. Some parts@were made recently, others over a thousand years ago.
O-Over a thousand years ago?!@A robot can last that long?!
That's not so surprising.@For example, the <Choukijin> and <Gan Eden>@were built thousands of years ago, right?
Th-That's true...
That said, the tech to keep a machine running@for a thousand years is pretty incredible.
But why were Touya and Katia registered@as pilots for a robot like that, anyway?
Ho ho ho, that's a good point, coming from you.
Huh, really?
Touya's father and Katia and Melua's parents@worked for <Ashurey Kreuzer>. They're probably@the ones who registered them in the Granteed...
But why their own children?
Hmmm... Perhaps it's a kind of security, y'see.
Kenzo
Or perhaps the children have some special aptitude.
On what grounds?
The ring mounted above the rear seat.@It appears to detect the pilot's brainwaves@and thoughts.
So the Granteed has a device similar@to the <T-LINK System>...
Yes. I think we should examine the brains@of Touya Shiun, Katia Grineal,@and Seldoa Shiun.
Before that, y'see, I'd like Touya and Katia@to come activate the Granteed.@Otherwise, the investigation can't go forward.
Right.@Once Major Gilliam's questioning is over,@let's have them come here.
...There are others I'd like to call in as well.
Who?
Those who were involved with the <Sympathia>.
Josh and Rim? Why?
This is just my intuition, but...@the Granteed's man-machine interface@seems similar to the Sympathia.
Jinpu
All right, that finishes the equipment swap.
That took about as long as at our test site.
Well, with facilities like these, sure.@Five big crawler cranes underground?@Color me impressed.
That's the SRX Lab for you.
So, Jinpu. Are we handing it over@to the Instructors in GG configuration?
No, first we do a field test. I cleared it with the brass.@FF did a mock battle with the Compatible Kaiser,@but we don't have enough data on GG.
Who's doing the test?
You two, obviously.@C'mon, into the Soul Saber, chop chop.
Whaaat, right now?!
Yup. I want walking data at the very least.
I-It's almost 11 at night, you know?@Let us rest. We fought three real battles today...
Yeah, that's exactly it. Somethin' smells fishy.@I've got a bad feeling. Come tomorrow,@another war might break out, y'know?
That's a bit extreme... Right, Akimi?
I think Jinpu has a point.
(What, you're siding with him?@You were just saying you were tired...)
We should do what we can while we can.@Let's hand the Soul Saber over to the Instructors@in top shape. That's our job, isn't it?
I get that it's our job, but can't it wait till tomorrow?
I know you're tired, and I'd like@to let you rest... but like I said,@I've got a real bad feeling about this.
I know it's a lot to ask,@but would you do me this one favor?
Well, if you put it like that, I guess we have to...@Fine.
We're aboveground, Jinpu.
All righty. Now head over to <Tsumegigaoka>.
Huh? What?!
Operator
Multiple gravity quake readings directly above the base!
Sakae
Can you identify the <ES Wave Pattern>?!
Cross-checking now!
Prepare for anti-air combat.@PT units, scramble in sequence.
(Can we stop them at the shoreline@like we have so far...?)
Wait, are enemies coming?!
Jinpu, what's going on?!
I ain't gettin' any info over here,@but this is definitely no ordinary thing!@Damn it, my bad feeling was right!
Forget tomorrow, the enemy's back tonight!
This is just too much! I'm pulling back!
No, this is a chance to show what the Soul Saber can do!@Let's fight too!
Don't be stupid!@We've seen combat, but we're still basically amateurs!
Eleve 1 to all units!@We'll mop up any enemies the SHORADs miss!
The Soul Saber! It was outside?!
But it looks different...
That's the long-range GG configuration.
The enemy's here, right?! We'll help too!
Not needed. A little knowledge is a dangerous thing.
Urk...
Major Kai is right.@We have to stay out of everyone else's way.
ES Wave Pattern resembles the Zovorg!@Transfer emergence imminent!
Fire!
Eleve 1 to all units!@Spread out and mop up the remaining enemies!
Roger!
Major Kai, what shall we be doin'@with the Soul Saber, sirree?
We can't open the hangar hatch now.@Soul Saber, withdraw outside the base.@Kota, back them up.
You got it!
Akimi! We're getting out of here like they said!
H-Hey! Wait!
Sorry, but I'm the one piloting!
New gravity quake readings above the base!
Enemy reinforcements! All personnel, stay alert!
Enemy units emerging! Five of them!
Ah!
Enemies over there!
Kyaaah!!
Akemi!
We're in trouble if they surround us!@Full boost and break through!
Break through to where?!
The sea, the sea!@We can't head toward the town, can we?!
The sea...?!
GG is heavy, it accelerates worse than FF!@Hurry!
Turning our back to run is dangerous!@GG has thick armor, so we'll defend and hold out!
So run a damage check on your end too!@If there's any armor we should purge, tell me!
R-Right!
...I thought she'd panic,@but she recovered quickly.
Yes, Akemi may be the steadier one, being the@big sister. Being twins may have something to do@with it, but they make a good team, don't they?
All units near <Tsumegigaoka>, intercept the new@enemies and cover the Soul Saber!
Commander, all enemy units shot down.@No new gravity quake readings either.
They used no decisive blow like fuel-air bombs at the@outset, and for reinforcements that got so close,@they didn't push very hard.
Their objective clearly wasn't to seize or destroy@this base... Perhaps attacking here was the@objective itself.
Reconnaissance in force, sir?
I can't say for now, but tighten security@inside and outside the base.
Here they come, Akemi! Don't get taken out!
You don't have to tell me!@I won't let them wreck the Soul Saber@after all the work we put into it!
...I see. Understood. Thank you.
The fighting has ended. Let's resume the questioning.
You seem more wary than nervous.
I've never been interrogated by the military before.
This isn't an interrogation.@We're simply hearing your side of things.@You may stay silent on anything you'd rather not say.
How democratic.
You're bona fide Federation citizens,@registered in the government database.
...Do you really think that?@Including my father?
An autopsy on Mr. Seldoa Shiun's body is being@performed at the base's medical facility.@It depends on the results.
(And if they find something, what then...?)
Earlier, pilots from the Special Tactics@Instructor Unit boarded the Granteed,@but they couldn't activate it.
That leads to three hypotheses. Either your biometrics@are stored in that machine, or you have recognition@devices implanted in you...
Or you yourselves have some special ability.
But... I'm just an ordinary person.
So am I.
Me too.
Yet the Granteed was built with <EOT>...@the super-technology of extraterrestrial intelligences.@Where did Seldoa Shiun obtain it...?
Touya, did he tell you anything?
No...
Then did he say anything else?
The imperial family... the imperial family's sword...@And something like Sentinel Commander?@But I don't know what any of it means.
An imperial family... A royal house, then.@I wonder of what nation.
I have no idea about anything like that.
Then what is the imperial family's sword?
That's...@probably the Granteed, I think.
Anything else that caught your attention?
My father called himself@E-Selda Shune.
E-Selda?
Of course, it was news to me. No idea what it means.@Maybe Shune was supposed to be Shiun, but...
Katia, Melua.@Does the word E-Selda sound familiar?
No, it doesn't...
So did I...
(Imperial family, Sentinel Commander, E-Selda...@So these are the keywords.@Perhaps I should ask that man as well.)
All right, everyone. Let's end here for today.@Please go back to your rooms and rest.
For a while there I didn't know what'd happen...@Never figured Akemi would hang tough like that.
From that position we could've escaped off base fast,@but if we'd done that, the town of Shimoda@might've been hit, right?
Besides, I figured with the GG configuration,@we could hold out even if I couldn't fight well.
Nah, that was some pretty good piloting.
Yeah, you'd never guess it was your first real fight.
I watched Akimi doing the fighting, so strictly@speaking, it wasn't my first time, but...
If you'd taken every hit head-on, it wouldn't have@held up, no matter how thick the armor. It means@you had the technique to dodge and deflect.
I was just desperate. It was thanks to the machine.
But put another way, doesn't that prove the Soul@Saber can get results even with someone without@combat experience at the controls?
What do you think, Hugo?
No objection here.
Hearin' that from a pro sure makes@an engineer like me happy.
Heh, me too, as the test pilot!
Akemi's one thing, but Akimi'll get a big head,@so let's leave it at that.
Understood.
Aw, come on, Jinpu.@If I'd had the FF configuration, I'd have...
No, this one's on me.
Huh?
If I had a bad feeling, I could've chosen@not to send you two out...@and I ended up puttin' you in danger anyway.
I won't be able to face the president after this.
But you got the GG configuration's walking data, right?
Better than that, I got combat data too.
Then it all worked out.@Once it's optimized, we can hand over@the Soul Saber, right?
Yeah.
So,@our test pilot job's over for now...@and next is the questioning, huh?
Anyway, you can call it a day.@If anything happens, we'll handle it.
Okay. Then we'll go get some rest first.@Let's go, Akimi.
Yes...
(Is it really okay... to end it here?)
Mekibos
I asked my homeland about the Drift Wing,@the Sleeping Beauty, E-Selda and Sentinel Commander.@They came up with nothing.
I see...
Well, I'll check some other sources too.
Then what about the combat actions@by <Zovorg> machines?
Like I told your superiors, the <Privy Council>@knows nothing about it.
Can I trust those words?
I've got nothing to gain by lying here.@I'm practically a hostage locked up in Paris.@One wrong move could cost me my life.
Indeed.
But as you know,@the Zovorg aren't a monolith.@If somebody's working behind the scenes, I'd guess...
Golaikunru.
The Zovorg's war merchants...@I'd like your homeland to look into it too.
Of course, but...@at the end of <The Sealing War>, a lot of the machines@<Zezenan> and his lot used were abandoned.
If someone captured those and is using them,@there's no way for us to keep track, y'know?
